hypothesis: A five-asset shared-account canary restricted to six explicitly selected bidirectional routes may produce cleaner and more frequent forward evidence than v28's mixture of 23 executable mappings, while preserving one-position-per-asset isolation and exact backend telemetry.
decision: Retain v29 as inactive and unchanged while materially updating its shared-account evidence. The first exact six-route priority replay is positive under both nominal and stressed modeled friction, exercises both directions on every route, rejects only overlapping ETH lifecycles, and never reaches the five-position ceiling. This supports aggregate capacity and conflict feasibility but does not establish broad route edge: SOL Range Onset supplies 65.76% of positive nominal route PnL and 69.72% under stress, while SP500 breakout pressure and GOLD Swing/HA are negative in both scenarios. The concentration exceeds revision 3's prospective falsifier and requires explicit review rather than automatic promotion, pruning, restart, drain, order, close, resize, or protection changes.
falsifier: The diagnostic is invalidated by any mismatch in the frozen v29 profile fingerprint, six-route scope, source hashes, opened development/validation phase contract, shared-equity reconciliation, one-position-per-asset ownership, five-slot ceiling, route attribution, or report-only authority. Its economic interpretation is updated by a common-window replay, private-fill event replay, or forward live sample that removes or worsens the measured SOL concentration, reverses the negative SP500 or GOLD components, produces nonpositive aggregate after-cost PnL, materially increases drawdown or friction, or demonstrates unmodeled opposite-intent exits. These remain reported results rather than implicit runtime gates.
limitations: The replay uses already-opened development and validation evidence and is not a sealed holdout or a future-profit forecast.
Source windows differ by route: crypto evidence spans up to one year, while selected HIP-3 routes cover shorter and different intervals.
Nominal and stress HIP-3 lifecycle counts differ because the source simulator resolves friction-dependent paths; the stress delta is not a pure fee-only comparison.
Precomputed independent exits cannot reproduce an opposite provider closing an owned same-asset lifecycle early.
HIP-3 entry cash reservation approximates the entry leg as half of observed round-trip fees while each source net PnL remains after-cost.
Completed-bar replay cannot establish private IOC fills, queue position, acknowledgement latency, stop gaps, or future funding and slippage.
Realized-equity drawdown omits concurrent intratrade mark-to-market paths and liquidation-path stress.
The positive aggregate is materially concentrated in SOL Range Onset and does not prove edge for SP500 breakout pressure or GOLD Swing/HA.
No live route, process, order, position, stop, target, allocation, transition drain, or protection changed in this revision.
